title: Greetings to Barbara Reid
summary: Lee and Mary send greetings to Barbara Reid, recalling the Victory Club and Roosevelt Hotel jazz club days.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah, but I feel bad at all times. I'm going to say this to my great old friend Barbara Reid. Hello, Barbara. I sure love to live to see you again, babe. From the good old days at the Victory Club. When you and Bill and the gang would come to see, would knock me out. Would do me all the good. You people was a great inspiration to me. And I always think of you, Barbara. I haven't seen you since the good old days up in the... Where I played for the Jazz Club. The Roosevelt Hotel. So... Be sweet. Hope to see you some good old days. Your old friend Lee Collins. And don't forget little Mary. Mary won't tell you hello there. Tell her all, Mary.
Hello, Barbara. I wish you were here with us. And we often talk about you.
She had a lot of fun in those days.
Yes, we did. She had a lot of fun in those days. ¶¶
